lyric_cues.cue: Wind in the wire and the porch light low
Something in the field that I used to know
Two ears turning where the quiet goes
Listening for the song before it shows
Rain on the tin and a dog down the lane
Footsteps counting out the same refrain
Left ear, right ear, tell me what you heard
One sound or two, or just a single word
